subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): failed raw channel sends report success

question: Should the legacy raw adapter now treat `ok: false` as a rejected delivery while retaining `buildChannelSendResult` for direct compatibility callers?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and preserves the exported helper, but this is an externally consumable Plugin SDK behavior change whose existing consumer expectations cannot be established from the adapter implementation alone.

options.title: Adopt boundary rejection
options.body: Merge the adapter-only rejection behavior, preserving direct helper normalization as this branch does.

options.title: Retain resolved failures
options.body: Keep legacy adapters resolving failed raw results only if maintainers intentionally support consumers inspecting `ok` and `error` after adapter sends.

recommendation.title: Adopt boundary rejection
recommendation.body: Merge the adapter-only rejection behavior, preserving direct helper normalization as this branch does.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and added the final compatibility-focused regression case.
